items.company: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute

desc: Built a PySide6 screen recorder capturing video and user actions across Windows apps (Word, Excel, Chrome, Edge, Firefox) with timestamped event logs.
Integrated Playwright to align video frames with UI actions and DOM selectors, generating paired training data (frame + action sequence) for VLM fine-tuning.
OCR Model (PyTorch + FastAPI): Fine-tuned TrOCR with a synthetic image data generator server (diverse fonts + noise injection) to improve real-world generalization without manual labelling
Frontend: Built responsive Flutter app targeting Web + iOS with MVVM architecture; implemented caching strategies and WebSocket for real-time OCR status updates.

Backend (Node.js + MongoDB): Designed RESTful APIs with chunked uploads for large PDFs, Bull queue for async OCR job scheduling, and worker pool for parallel page processing—achieving 1,000+ docs/hour with 99.9% uptime and 35% faster queries.
As the first project at the company, rapidly onboarded Flutter with MVVM architecture and MongoDB to design and deliver a responsive model monitoring dashboard.
Designed and implemented unit and integration tests, utilizing dependency injections and mocking to verify page navigation and widget states.
Drafted the whitepaper: Federated Learning: Unlocking Innovation in the Insurance Sector

projects.proj: Social Listening Platform in Greater Bay Area -- TOURMETER
desc: Model Development: Built SOTA multi-lingual (Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and English) sentiment models (CNN, Bi-LSTM) with >90% accuracy and a topic-relevance classifier for tourism relevance

Real-time Data Scraping System: Built a 24/7 scraping engine collecting >10T real-time data from major social media/news platforms (Weibo, Twitter, Facebook, etc.) with anti-blocking mechanisms including dynamic IP rotation and human behavior simulation
Product Deployment: Created an interactive vanilla JavaScript + D3.js dashboard delivering real-time tourism insights and policy recommendations to government stakeholders
Model Development: Fine-tuned NER models (BERT/RoBERTa) for search query understanding.
Data Pipeline: Built an automated data labeling generator using external knowledge bases (Wikipedia/Freebase) to produce large-scale training data from unannotated search logs.
Product Deployment: Deployed the model as a FastAPI service on AWS and developed a Manifest Chrome Extension that highlights entities instantly upon user text selection.
